**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Section 15.6 (Assignment)** is fine — mutual, with an express no-consent carve-out for assignment to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, stock sale or sale of substantially all assets (including by operation of law), backed by a guarantee mechanic. That meets the preferred position; the lack of a "not unreasonably withheld" qualifier on other assignments is noted only, not flagged.
- **Section 14.2.6** is the failure: SFJ may terminate the entire Agreement "in its sole discretion" following a Change of Control of PB, and PB must then pay 150% of SFJ's Development Costs. A counterparty termination/re-pricing right triggered by our change of control is walk-away territory and undercuts the assignment freedom in 15.6.
- Redline (validated, ok:true): delete SFJ's change-of-control termination right and the 150% payment, replacing them with an express statement that a Change of Control gives SFJ no termination or payment-acceleration right, subject to successor assumption/guarantee under Section 15.6; the purely consequential paragraph (p0766) is deleted as conforming. PB's own Change of Control Buy-Out Option (6.7.2) benefits us and was not flagged.
